verdict.rationale: Circle exposes a dedicated StableFX quote API that creates trade quotes between two currencies, with executable 'tradable' quotes and indicative 'reference' quotes, plus settlement-advance endpoints. CPN offers real-time FX quotes with USDC settlement 'near-instantly, 24/7', and Circle Mint converts USD to and from USDC at no additional cost (a commenter corroborates par mint/redeem with no spread). missing for 10: an evidenced programmatic API for the fiat↔stablecoin leg (Mint is described only as an account for qualified businesses), documented per-pair rates/fee schedules for StableFX, explicit settlement-time documentation for conversions, and hands-on corroboration of executed conversions.
